sectionReplaces.heading: # DEPLOYMENT STATE
sectionReplaces.content:
- Hosting: GitHub Pages, Jekyll, baseurl /english.
- Latest verified implementation commit: 6e37433 (Batch 13 closing commit: inbound internal links from 6 published scooter reviews; articles published in part-commits a58bb52/37abf1c with a front-matter repair of 10 guides in b4c9808 — 13 model comparisons, 10 choosing guides, 12 spec explainers; batch-13 matrix rows and README state merged server-side by the docs-sync bot commit 9ac0d0f). Verified 2026-09-23: the live /articles/ index renders the 567-guide total, the /topics/scooters/ hub renders the 110-guide count, and 10 of the 35 new article pages spot-checked live resolve with correct content.
- Latest verified Quality Gate runs: 35871367548 (commit b4c9808, success, all steps) and 35871816160 (commit 6e37433, success, all steps) on 2026-09-23. The part-commit gates failed transiently (a58bb52 run 35870231744 on forward internal links; 37abf1c run 35870434290 on the front-matter corruption repaired in b4c9808 — see docs/matrix/batch-13-status.md).
- Latest verified Pages run: 35871855319 (docs-sync bot commit 9ac0d0f, the deployed batch-13 state; success, 2026-09-23). The Pages run for the repair commit b4c9808 (35871365413) also succeeded.
- Batch-12 state for reference: 532 articles, final commit d06dae8, gate run 35863983644, Pages run 35863983933 (see docs/matrix/batch-12-status.md).
- README-only state updates may create a newer HEAD than the SHAs recorded here; the values above always refer to the last implementation commit whose CI/deploy was actually verified. Matrix-row and README merges run server-side via the Docs Sync workflow (scripts/apply-batch-docs.js, payloads docs/sync/*.json).
